---
title: "Single-allele analysis of Tet spot distance & RNA signal"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| include: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(data.table)
library(ggthemes)
library(SpatialTools)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
```

---

### Input parameters

```{r input-variables}
GLOB_C <- "*nuclei_information_well*" 
GLOB_S <- "*spots_locations_well*" 
XY_RES <- 0.066 # Pixel size (um)
THRESHOLD1_CH2_CH3 <- 0.18  # 5'-3' distance threshold (um) to define proximal vs distal 5'-3' boundaries
THRESHOLD2_CH2_CH3 <- 0.6  # 5'-3' distance threshold (um) to define alleles that have no 3'boundary spots
THRESHOLD3_CH3_CH1 <- 0.8 # 5'-RNA distance threshold (um) to define alleles as active vs inactive
THRESHOLD4_CH1_INT <- 300 # Intensity threshold for RNA spots
```

---

### Download data in data folder if needed

```{r}
#| label: download
```

---

### Read cell data

```{r}
#| label: read-cells

pathsC <- dir_info("data/ch1k7_ch2k5_ch3k5",
                  recurse = TRUE,
                  glob = GLOB_C) %>%
  pull(path)

cell_tbl <- map_dfr(pathsC, \(p) {
  fread(p, select = c("Experiment", "cell_index")) %>%
    mutate(file_name = as.character(p), .before = 1)
}) %>%
  select(file_name, Experiment, cell_index)
```

---

### Read spot data 

```{r}
#| label: read-spots

pathsS <- dir_info("data/ch1k7_ch2k5_ch3k5",
                  recurse = TRUE,
                  glob = GLOB_S) %>%
  pull(path)

spots_tbl <- map_dfr(pathsS, \(p) {
  fread(
    p,
    select = c("Experiment", "channel", "cell_index",
               "V1", "x_location", "y_location", "integrated_intensity")
  ) %>%
    filter(cell_index != 0) %>%
    transmute(
      file_name = as.character(p),
      Experiment,
      channel,
      spot_index = V1,
      x = x_location * XY_RES,
      y = y_location * XY_RES,
      cell_index,
      integrated_intensity
    )
})

###Add 3'boundary (channel 2) spot data from other folders inside data directory
base_dir   <- file.path("data", "ch1k7_ch2k5_ch3k5")
other_dirs <- dir_info("data", type = "directory") %>%
  pull(path) %>%
  setdiff(base_dir)

new_ch2_spots <- map_dfr(other_dirs, \(dir_path) {

  paths <- dir_info(dir_path, recurse = TRUE, glob = GLOB_S) %>%
    pull(path)

  map_dfr(paths, \(p) {
    fread(
      p,
      select = c("Experiment", "channel", "V1",
                 "x_location", "y_location", "cell_index",
                 "integrated_intensity")
    ) %>%
      filter(channel == 2, cell_index != 0) %>%
      transmute(
        file_name = as.character(p),
        Experiment,
        channel,
        spot_index = V1,
        x = x_location * XY_RES,
        y = y_location * XY_RES,
        cell_index,
        integrated_intensity
      )
  })
})

spots_tbl <- bind_rows(spots_tbl, new_ch2_spots)
```

---

### Calculate spot number per cell

```{r}
#| label: calc-n-spots

cell_n_spots_tbl <- spots_tbl %>%
  group_by(Experiment, cell_index, channel) %>%
  count() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = channel,
              names_prefix = "n_spots_channel_",
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  ungroup()
```

---

### Filter cells according to spot number per cell

```{r}
#| label: filter-cells

spot_filt_criterion <- quote(n_spots_channel_3 >= 1 & n_spots_channel_2 >= 1)

cell_n_spots_filt_tbl <- cell_n_spots_tbl %>%
  semi_join(cell_tbl, by = c("Experiment","cell_index")) %>%
  filter(!!spot_filt_criterion)
```

---

### Filter spots for filtered cells

```{r}
#| label: filter-spots

spot_filt_tbl <- spots_tbl %>% 
  semi_join(cell_n_spots_filt_tbl, 
            by = c("Experiment", "cell_index")) %>%
  as.data.table()
```

---

### Calculate minimum 5'-3' boundary spot distances

```{r}
#| label: ch3-spot-selection

# Get the highest intensity 5'boundary spot (channel 3) per cell
ch3_spots_selected <- spot_filt_tbl %>%
  filter(channel == 3) %>%
  group_by(Experiment, cell_index) %>%
  slice_max(integrated_intensity, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Experiment, cell_index, ch3_x = x, ch3_y = y, ch3_intensity = integrated_intensity)

ch2_spots <- spot_filt_tbl %>%
  filter(channel == 2) %>%
  select(Experiment, cell_index, spot_index, ch2_x = x, ch2_y = y, ch2_intensity = integrated_intensity)

# Calculate distance between 5' spot and all 3' spots in the same cell
ch2_ch3_distances <- ch3_spots_selected %>%
  left_join(ch2_spots, 
            by = c("Experiment", "cell_index"),
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(ch2_ch3_distance = sqrt((ch2_x - ch3_x)^2 + (ch2_y - ch3_y)^2))

# Get the closest 3' spot for each 5' spot
ch2_ch3_closest <- ch2_ch3_distances %>%
  group_by(Experiment, cell_index) %>%
  slice_min(ch2_ch3_distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Experiment, cell_index, closest_ch2_spot = spot_index, 
         ch2_ch3_distance, ch2_x, ch2_y, ch2_intensity, ch3_x, ch3_y, ch3_intensity)
```

---

### Classify cells based on 5'-3' boundary distance

```{r}
#| label: classify-ch2-ch3

ch2_ch3_classified <- ch2_ch3_closest %>%
  mutate(ch3_proximity = case_when(
    ch2_ch3_distance < THRESHOLD1_CH2_CH3 ~ "Proximal",
    ch2_ch3_distance >= THRESHOLD1_CH2_CH3 & ch2_ch3_distance < THRESHOLD2_CH2_CH3 ~ "Distal",
    ch2_ch3_distance >= THRESHOLD2_CH2_CH3 ~ "No 3' spot",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
```

---

### Calculate 5'boundary-RNA spot distance and classify alleles by activity status

```{r}
#| label: classify-ch3-ch1

# Get RNA spots
ch1_spots <- spot_filt_tbl %>%
  filter(channel == 1) %>%
  select(Experiment, cell_index, ch1_spot_index = spot_index, ch1_x = x, ch1_y = y, ch1_intensity = integrated_intensity)

# Calculate distance between 5'boundary spot and all RNA spots in the same cell
ch3_ch1_distances <- ch2_ch3_classified %>%
  left_join(ch1_spots, 
            by = c("Experiment", "cell_index"),
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(ch3_ch1_distance = sqrt((ch3_x - ch1_x)^2 + (ch3_y - ch1_y)^2))

# Get the closest RNA spot for each 5' spot
ch3_ch1_closest <- ch3_ch1_distances %>%
  group_by(Experiment, cell_index) %>%
  slice_min(ch3_ch1_distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Classify alleles as Active/Inactive
spots_classified <- ch2_ch3_classified %>%
  left_join(
    ch3_ch1_closest %>% 
      select(Experiment, cell_index,
             closest_ch1_spot = ch1_spot_index, ch3_ch1_distance, 
             ch1_x, ch1_y, ch1_intensity),
    by = c("Experiment", "cell_index")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace ch1_int with NA when ch1_int is too low or ch1 spot is too far
   ch1_intensity = if_else(
      ch1_intensity < THRESHOLD4_CH1_INT | ch3_ch1_distance > THRESHOLD3_CH3_CH1,
      NA_real_,
      ch1_intensity
    ),
    # Classify using the updated ch1_intensity
    activity_status = case_when(
  !is.na(ch1_intensity) ~ "Active",
  TRUE ~ "Inactive"
    )
  )

# Extract experiment name
spots_classified <- spots_classified %>%
  mutate(experiment_name = str_remove(Experiment, "_\\d+\\.czi$"))
# Filter out cells with "No 3' spot" classification
spots_classified <- spots_classified %>%
  filter(ch3_proximity != "No 3' spot")

# Save table with individual spot information
write_csv(spots_classified, "individual_allele_data.csv")
```

---

### Calculate fraction of active/inactive alleles according to 5'-3' proximity status

```{r}
#| label: proximity-activity-analysis

proximity_activity_summary <- spots_classified %>%
  group_by(experiment_name, ch3_proximity, activity_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    mean_ch1_intensity_active = if_else(
      first(activity_status) == "Active",
      mean(ch1_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    median_ch1_intensity_active = if_else(
      first(activity_status) == "Active",
      median(ch1_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(experiment_name, ch3_proximity) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cells = sum(n_cells),
    fraction = n_cells / total_cells
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Save to CSV file
write_csv(proximity_activity_summary, "proximity_activity_summary.csv")
```
